summary: Well-architected solution with strong TDD methodology and proper CI/CD integration. Workflow correctly uses pinned action refs, least-privilege permissions, and proper job dependencies. Both scripts follow bash conventions (set -euo pipefail, proper quoting, error handling via die()). Minor issues: workflow uses [ ] (POSIX) while script prefers [[ ]]; conventional commit regex patterns (e.g., lines 65-72 in bump_version.sh) are simple but functional, though scattered across determine_bump() and render_changelog_entry()—could centralize regex constants for maintenance. Fixture-based test harness is elegant (run_act_tests.sh correctly builds ephemeral repos, runs act, validates output via act-result.txt). Changelog rendering groups commits well. Edge case: sed regex for package.json assumes well-formed JSON (line 26—no null/escaping edge cases); minor but acceptable for the task scope. Would ship.
